Designed by a lunatic, this weapon’s inner mechanisms are extremely unreliable and seemingly cursed, changing from barely working to supercharged at near random. Its capabilities are impossible to predict, which can make it easy to fall in love with, but difficult to trust.

Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: ?d6 • Capacity: ? • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 2 rounds in a burst. If there are not 2 rounds left in the magazine, Single Shot expends the entire magazine. When this weapon is Reloaded, roll 1d20. The result determines the weapon’s Capacity (Minimum 2), with a result of 20 adding 6 additional 6 rounds (26 total). Then roll 1d8. The result is how many d6’s are rolled for this weapon’s Single Shot damage. Then roll 1d4. The result is how much SP the weapon ablates whenever it would ablate armor.

If this weapon is reloaded too often (at GM discretion), its capacitors will malfunction and be considered Damaged. By default, this weapon’s stats start at a 20 round Capacity, 3d6 damage, and 1 SP Ablation.

Whenever this weapon incurs a Critical Injury, roll 1d12 on the Critical Injury Table rather than 2d6, with a 1 meaning no Critical Injury is applied, but the Bonus Damage still occurs. Then roll 1d10. The result is how much Bonus Damage the Critical Injury causes.

Despite being Iconic, this weapon can load Non-Basic Ammunition. However, when purchasing Non-Basic Ammunition for this weapon, roll a 1d100 and multiply it by 5. The result is how many eurodollars the ammunition in question costs to buy on that specific day. Incompatible with Pistol Autosear.

NOTE: This is an utter abomination of true chaos. Only toss it at your players if you want to make their eyes go wide in fear. I am so sorry for what I have done.

####

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.
  • Corgo's starting stats: 20 round Capacity, 3d6 damage, 1 SP Ablation. The weapon re-rolls all three on every Reload (1d20 Capacity, 1d8 damage dice, 1d4 SP Ablation), which the sheet cannot do, so edit the item's damage and magazine by hand after each Reload.
  • Single Shot expends 2 rounds, and its Critical Injury roll is 1d12 rather than 2d6. Neither is automated.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
